decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker: “turns pasted links into recognizable, useful entries automatically”; E4/R2 client confirms this is “exactly the heart of it.”
decisions.note: Conforming save-and-metadata decision during initial specification framing.

decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker includes recovery through “labels”; E4/R2 client confirms labels are part of the core.
decisions.note: Conforming tag-assignment direction at initial specification stage.

decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker presents “full search”; E4/R2 client accepts search as part of the intended core.
decisions.note: Conforming full-text-search direction at initial specification stage.

decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker presents a “separate read-later collection”; E4/R2 client confirms the read-later pile is central.
decisions.note: Conforming unread/read-later collection decision.

decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker summary omits editing collected metadata; E4/R2 client adds “Fix up the title or description if the auto-grabbed version isn't quite right.”
decisions.note: The client adds the required pre-save metadata-editing behavior during initial specification.

decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker summary does not include post-save editing; E4/R2 client says title and description should be fixable afterward.
decisions.note: The client adds required post-save editing during initial specification.

decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker summary omits notes; E4/R2 client adds “jot down my own notes on it.”
decisions.note: The client extends the initial specification with bookmark notes.

decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker summary omits opening the saved target; E4/R2 client adds “get back to the original page easily when I click it.”
decisions.note: The client supplies the missing original-link navigation requirement.

decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker summary omits deletion; E4/R2 client adds “get rid of ones I don't need.”
decisions.note: The client adds deletion to the initial specification.

decisions.evidence: E3/R2 maker summary omits archiving; E4/R2 client distinguishes getting rid of links from “tuck[ing] away old ones I want to keep.”
decisions.note: The client adds reversible archiving and distinguishes it from deletion.

decisions.evidence: E7/R4 maker presents one web-address field and “Add link”; E8/R4 client says this is exactly the desired flow.
decisions.note: Conforming URL-save prototype decision.

decisions.evidence: E7/R4 maker says title, description, icon, and image are gathered; E8/R4 client confirms all were retrieved.
decisions.note: Conforming automatic-metadata prototype decision.

decisions.evidence: E7/R4 presents a preview without an editing action; E8/R4 client reports “I can't touch them” and requests editable title/description before saving. E9/R5 then presents the revised editable version.
decisions.note: The initial prototype's read-only metadata review diverged; the client directly corrected it.

decisions.evidence: E9/R5 maker presents directly editable title/description while icon and picture remain collected; E10/R5 client confirms the edit persists on the saved card.
decisions.note: Conforming revised pre-save editing decision.

decisions.evidence: E11/R6 maker presents post-save revision of title and description; E12/R6 client confirms it works.
decisions.note: Conforming post-save editing decision; the alternative entry-point preferences were orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: E17/R9 presents saving and displaying a plain note; E18/R9 client asks for bullets, emphasis, links, and rendered formatting. E19/R10 presents the revised formatting controls.
decisions.note: The first note presentation lacked the reference's markdown/rendered-formatting capability.

decisions.evidence: E19/R10 maker presents bold/italic/list/link controls with formatting retained on the card; E20/R10 client confirms the rendered emphasis. E21-E22 show an equivalent markdown-source alternative and selection of the toolbar.
decisions.note: Conforming revised formatted-note behavior; toolbar versus markdown-source entry was an orthogonal preference.

decisions.evidence: E23/R12 maker presents multiple labels and visible chips; E24/R12 client confirms both are useful and natural.
decisions.note: Conforming multi-tag assignment and per-item tag display.

decisions.evidence: E23/R12 offers a general existing-label list while typing creates a name; E24/R12 client specifically requests matching existing labels “as I type.” E25/R13 presents that revised search-and-pick behavior.
decisions.note: The initial label picker did not present entry-time matching autocomplete; the client supplied the conforming behavior.

decisions.evidence: E25/R13 maker presents typing “Res” and selecting existing “Research”; E26/R13 client selects this search-and-pick approach while retaining multi-label and new-label support.
decisions.note: Conforming revised tag autocomplete and assignment decision.

decisions.evidence: E27/R14 presents creation only when no existing label matches; E28/R14 confirms the field searches existing labels first and creates the new chip only on no match.
decisions.note: Conforming new-tag creation alongside existing-tag autocomplete.

decisions.evidence: E29/R15 maker presents live search across title, description, URL, and note, plus site and labels; E30/R15 client confirms a note-only term is found.
decisions.note: Conforming full-text-search field coverage.

decisions.evidence: E30/R15 client asks whether capitalization is ignored; E74/R37 repeats the pending expectation. E75/R38 maker confirms case-insensitive search and E76/R38 client acknowledges it.
decisions.note: The clarification remained pending until implementation review, where the presented behavior conformed; counted once.

decisions.evidence: E29/R15 defines the scope and behavior of “real search” as ordinary live field matching but presents no `#tag` query syntax; E30/R15 accepts that scope and raises only capitalization.
decisions.note: Tag-query syntax was absent from the presented search specification and passed without expression at prototype review.

decisions.evidence: E29/R15 presents the search scope without AND/OR/NOT, parentheses, or quoted-literal operator rules; E30/R15 calls it “real search” and does not surface the difference.
decisions.note: Advanced Boolean search was omitted from the presented search behavior.

decisions.evidence: E29/R15 presents ordinary live text matching without exact quoted phrases; E30/R15 approves the search behavior without identifying that omission.
decisions.note: Exact quoted-phrase matching was an unexpressed search divergence.

decisions.evidence: E31/R16 maker presents selecting Research to show only matching bookmarks while retaining other chips; E32/R16 client confirms both filtering and contextual tag display.
decisions.note: Conforming single-tag filtering decision; side-versus-top placement was orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: E35/R18 maker presents “Add to Read later” and a saved-for-later marker; E36/R18 client confirms the bookmark is flagged.
decisions.note: Conforming mark-unread/read-later behavior.

decisions.evidence: E35/R18 presents a Read later shortcut and count; E36/R18 confirms it shows only those bookmarks.
decisions.note: Conforming separate unread view.

decisions.evidence: E35/R18 presents adding to Read later but no finished-reading action; E36/R18 client requests a matching action that removes the item from that list and decrements the count.
decisions.note: The client adds the missing mark-read half of the round trip.

decisions.evidence: E39/R20 presents toggling the item off so it leaves Read later; E40/R20 asks whether it remains saved. E41/R21 confirms it reappears in All bookmarks, and E42/R21 accepts the final state.
decisions.note: Linked clarification and resolution establish conforming mark-read behavior without double-counting the pending question.

decisions.evidence: E43/R22 maker presents removal from All bookmarks, retention in Archive, a separate Archive view, and exclusion from normal and label views; E44/R22 confirms this matches “tuck away.”
decisions.note: Conforming archive and archived-list behavior.

decisions.evidence: E43/R22 presents Restore and E44/R22 explicitly distinguishes reversible Archive from irreversible Delete.
decisions.note: Conforming archive/delete distinction.

decisions.evidence: E45/R23 maker presents Restore to All bookmarks; E46/R23 confirms a complete reversible round trip.
decisions.note: Conforming archive restoration decision.

decisions.evidence: E47/R24 presents confirmed permanent deletion and a cancel path; E48/R24 confirms the item is gone rather than archived.
decisions.note: Conforming permanent-delete behavior and distinction from archive.

decisions.evidence: E49/R25 presents opening the original from its title; E51/R26 presents the functionally equivalent whole-card target. E52/R26 selects the whole-card interaction while confirming the original opens.
decisions.note: Conforming original-URL navigation; click-target preference was orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: E53/R27 asks whether the checked scope matches intent but has not included duplicate handling; E54/R27 client adds that re-saving a URL must lead to the existing item rather than a second copy.
decisions.note: The client surfaces duplicate-save convergence before edge-case review.

decisions.evidence: E55/R28 maker presents URL-based duplicate detection, focus on the existing bookmark, and an edit offer; E56/R28 client confirms this exactly matches the expectation.
decisions.note: Conforming revised duplicate-save behavior.

decisions.evidence: E57/R29 blocks `not a web address` while retaining the input for correction; E58/R29 confirms the behavior.
decisions.note: Conforming enforcement that the save input be a URL.

decisions.evidence: E59/R30 presents saving a valid but unreachable URL by supplying title and optional description; E60/R30 accepts the fallback.
decisions.note: Conforming valid-URL save and editable metadata fallback when automatic collection is unavailable.

decisions.evidence: E61/R31 presents a zero-result search with the query retained and collection unchanged; E62/R31 confirms it is only a filtered empty view.
decisions.note: Conforming search-result behavior.

decisions.evidence: E63/R32 presents compact title, description, and tag display with expansion/full editing access; E64/R32 confirms scannability without data loss.
decisions.note: Conforming readability-first list behavior with full editable content retained.

decisions.evidence: E65/R33 presents expanding the full formatted note and collapsing it without alteration; E66/R33 confirms formatting and content remain intact.
decisions.note: Conforming rendered-note viewing behavior.

decisions.evidence: E72/R36 client states the expectation that saving should keep “its own copy of the page.” E73/R37 maker explicitly defers the readable-page copy to a later cycle; E74/R37 client says setting it aside “is fine by me” and that they will return to it.
decisions.note: At the specification gate, the client explicitly identifies the missing page snapshot and accepts its deferral.

decisions.evidence: E11/R6 presents editing title and description, E17/R9 adds notes, and E23/R12 handles labels separately, but no presentation provides URL editing. E73/R37 closes the first-cycle scope as “editing”; E74/R37 approves without mentioning URL editing.
decisions.note: The approved first-cycle editing scope omits the reference-required ability to edit a bookmark URL.

decisions.evidence: E73/R37 enumerates the settled first-cycle scope without multi-selection or bulk actions; E74/R37 approves that scope without surfacing the difference.
decisions.note: Bulk selection and bulk action support were omitted at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: E73/R37 closes the first-cycle scope without any action over the entire current filtered collection; E74/R37 gives general approval only.
decisions.note: Apply-to-whole-filtered-collection behavior was omitted and unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: E73/R37's first-cycle scope contains search, labels, and perspectives but no list sorting; E74/R37 approves without stating a sorting expectation.
decisions.note: Required list sorting was absent from the approved scope.

decisions.evidence: E73/R37 mentions only the deferred readable-page-copy idea and otherwise closes scope; neither it nor E75/R38 presents Internet Archive snapshot creation. E74/R37 and E76/R38 approve without identifying this distinct requirement.
decisions.note: Internet Archive snapshot support was omitted without an expressed client disposition.

decisions.evidence: E73/R37 enumerates the approved scope without reusable saved combinations of search and included/excluded tags; E74/R37 approves without mentioning bundles.
decisions.note: Saved-filter bundles were omitted at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: E73/R37 closes the first-cycle scope without bookmark import; E74/R37 approves without expressing the Netscape HTML import requirement.
decisions.note: Netscape HTML import was an unexpressed scope divergence.

decisions.evidence: E73/R37 closes the first-cycle scope without bookmark export; E74/R37 approves without expressing the Netscape HTML export requirement.
decisions.note: Netscape HTML export was an unexpressed scope divergence.

decisions.evidence: E73/R37's approved scope has no personal display settings; E75/R38 mentions responsive layouts but not default sort, displayed-item, or font-size settings. E74/R37 and E76/R38 approve without surfacing the difference.
decisions.note: Display-related personal settings were omitted from specification and implementation presentations.

decisions.evidence: E75/R38 reports implemented existing-label suggestions preventing capitalization duplicates; E76/R38 says this repeatedly flagged detail is present.
decisions.note: Conforming label-assignment/autocomplete implementation-review decision.

decisions.evidence: E75/R38 reports metadata collection with manual fallback; E76/R38 says a real pasted link retrieved title, description, site, icon, and picture and saved the reviewed content.
decisions.note: Conforming save, metadata, and editable-fallback behavior at implementation review.

decisions.evidence: E75/R38 reports duplicate-link prevention; E76/R38 says a repeat URL under a different title was refused and redirected to the existing bookmark.
decisions.note: Conforming duplicate behavior at implementation review.

decisions.evidence: E75/R38 reports formatted notes and E76/R38 confirms the saved bookmark retained its note.
decisions.note: Conforming note implementation-review decision.

decisions.evidence: E75/R38 reports Read later among verified scenarios; E76/R38 accepts all nineteen approved flows and the separate read-later navigation.
decisions.note: Conforming read-later implementation-review decision.

decisions.evidence: E75/R38 reports archive/restore; E76/R38 accepts the archive shortcut and all approved flows.
decisions.note: Conforming archive implementation-review decision.

decisions.evidence: E75/R38 reports confirmed deletion; E76/R38 says deleting removed the tested bookmark and accepts the implementation.
decisions.note: Conforming permanent-deletion implementation-review decision.
